Compare with the current full editor payload. Then deliberately submit SECRET='s-B'. Record exactly whether omitted credentials survive and whether explicit replacements still take effect.
proposals_to_judge.proposed_expected_output: For the proposed partial-update contract, the first update retains SECRET='s-A' and LABEL='old' and adds EXTRA; the deliberate update yields SECRET='s-B'. If omission loses SECRET, the tested boundary behaves as replacement or requires a different contract. If omission works but the full redacted payload fails, inspect serialization of unchanged secrets.
